name: Analog Rytm
summary: OS 1.74 rebuilt in the browser builder (ELE2); marked builds boot, stock restores, DIN recovery works; the MKII base built for the MKI passed on a unit.

firmware.flash: Elektron Transfer over USB: set MIDI IN and OUT to the device, drop the .syx on and press YES on the device. It restarts by itself.
firmware.recovery: Recovery mode is MIDI DIN ONLY: the startup menu does not take USB. Hold FUNC at power-on, TRIG 4 (OS UPGRADE), and send the owner's stock .syx over MIDI DIN from a USB-MIDI interface plugged straight into the Rytm's MIDI IN (Transfer cannot send in the startup menu; a paced sender works, docs/RYTM_MKI_OS_RESEARCH.md).

research.label: rytm-emu MK1 port notes
research.note: Rytm MKI OS 1.74 and A4 MKI 1.56 in an emulator: ELE2 header, MCF5441x, NOR flash, 122x32 LCD, full-speed USB. Boots stock 1.74 to the main screen. No firmware hosted.

research.label: elektron-firmware-tool
research.note: Documents the SysEx transport, ELE2 container and aPLib codec that Modwerk's ele2.ts reads and rebuilds (docs/RYTM_MKI_OS_RESEARCH.md). No firmware hosted.
